why: Filmstrip from the turn-back move shows us swinging around through the office area and back to the gate-1/mosaic-mat area, and now at z~1.00 (descended from cruise altitude) with the yellow gate posts framing the forward view again - this matches a final approach over the mat area rather than a re-transit (heading is now back past both gates, pose track confirms). The downward view shows a light rounded object in the mat area, partly obscured by the drone's own airframe, plausibly the stuffed animal, and it's roughly centered/below. This is the smallest, slowest move of the flight (peak speed 0.12 m/s, near-hold), consistent with the doctrine's guidance that a small move while something is below IS the task. Approving as the final hold/fine-adjust over the target for this last decision.
